metrics.description: This object contains the registered metric results and applicability reasons.

domain_results.description: These results partition opportunities by their primary reporting domain.

value_0_100.description: Non-authoritative legacy UI approximation. Never use this field to calculate a result.

enabled_components.description: These component names identify the fixed inputs used by the composite.

reason.description: This field explains why a metric or decision is unavailable under the stated enumeration.

display.description: Native exact half-up one decimal display; not an arithmetic input.

composite.description: Policy-derived primary grade; answer-components-v2 excludes optional explanation while historical frozen policies retain their original definition.

item_decision_ids.description: These IDs identify the saved decisions that support the feedback item.

semantic_judgments_present.description: This flag states that the result depends on semantic judgments in addition to arithmetic.

G.description: Number of all confirmed true-error units.

TP.description: Number of distinct true units with a supported error assertion.

FP.description: Number of resolved false error assertions after duplicate removal.

LC.description: Number of TP units with an explicit valid category.

LF.description: Number of those categories in the correct reporting domain.

LE.description: Number of those categories in the permitted exact-leaf set.

GC.description: Number of all correction-eligible true units.

CA.description: Number of those TP units with a supplied correction.

anyOf.description: Number of supplied eligible corrections with credit exactly one.

CK.description: Known correction statistic, or null when an included correction is genuinely unresolved; cannot be null solely due to optional explanation uncertainty.

GE.description: Number of all explanation-eligible true units.

EA.description: Number of those TP units with a supplied explanation.

anyOf.description: Number of supplied eligible explanations with credit exactly one.

EK.description: Known original population statistic, null while any eligible optional explanation credit is unresolved; never hide that row.

FC.description: Number of FP assertions with an unnecessary correction.

DF.description: Number of distinct designated controls wrongly flagged.

DA.description: Number of designated controls explicitly identified as permitted.

SN.description: Number of explicit judgments mapped to true units or controls.

SA.description: Number of those judgments that agree with the key.

WTP.description: Sum of weights for detected true units.

WFN.description: Sum of weights for missed true units.

H.description: Sum of hierarchical credit for the TP units.

anyOf.description: Sum of correction credit for eligible TP units.

CQ.description: Known correction statistic, or null when an included correction is genuinely unresolved; cannot be null solely due to optional explanation uncertainty.

anyOf.description: Sum of explanation credit for eligible TP units.

EQ.description: Known original population statistic, null while any eligible optional explanation credit is unresolved; never hide that row.

WFP.description: `FP`, with the existing fixed false-assertion weight of one.

sufficient_statistics.description: These counts and sums permit exact recomputation of the metric ratios.

value.description: This field contains the numeric result or null under the parent applicability rule.

status.description: This field states the parent operation result from its declared enumeration.

reason.description: This field explains why a metric or decision is unavailable under the stated enumeration.

optional_explanation.description: This ratio measures proposition-based explanation credit among proposed explanations.

unit_id.description: Exact frozen key unit; empty only for an off-key assertion.

kind.description: Native finding kind from truth, source stance and component finality.

category_id.description: Primary key category, or the actual attributed category for an off-key assertion; empty when unattributed.

decision_ids.description: Saved consolidated source representatives supporting this finding.

target_texts.description: Exact target quotes from the frozen rendered-text key.

repairs.description: Permitted authored text alternatives and IPA when supplied; not a requirement to type IPA.

rationale.description: Stored key rationale; optional user explanations are assessed separately.

audio_intervals.description: Actual final-audio intervals from the key; containing-turn timing is retained when finer timing was unavailable.

reference.description: Post-submission key text, permitted repairs, rationale and actual containing audio interval; this does not certify a requested acoustic operation.

items.description: Native per-unit recording findings and supported off-key assertions. Excluded units are omitted; unresolved detection is not a confirmed miss.
